description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants to lip-sync an existing video clip to a track. Upload the clip with upload_video and audio with upload_audio first, then poll get_task_status and fetch get_task_result. For a singing photo, use generate_singing_video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: Set true only after the user explicitly accepts an unknown total, without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; this does not enforce a total budget.

audio_duration_ms.description: The audio duration in milliseconds. Required with audio_url.

audio_url.description: A direct audio URL. Requires audio_duration_ms. Set this or music_id, not both.

max_credits.description: User-approved ceiling for a known current quote. Cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run. Never remove or raise it without new user consent.

music_id.description: An analyzed music_id from upload_audio. Set this or audio_url, not both.

name.description: A display name for the creation.

remove_watermark.description: Remove the Freebeat watermark if the account allows it.

name: generate_lip_sync_video

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
